metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.2 · 1962 · Dr. No
metas.description: A resourceful British government agent seeks answers in a case involving the disappearance of a colleague and the disruption of the American space program.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.3 · 1963 · From Russia with Love
metas.description: James Bond willingly inserts himself into an assassination plot involving a naive Russian beauty in order to retrieve a Soviet encryption device that was stolen by the evil SPECTRE organization.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 7.7 · 1964 · Goldfinger
metas.description: While investigating a gold magnate's smuggling, James Bond uncovers a plot to contaminate the Fort Knox gold reserve.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.9 · 1965 · Thunderball
metas.description: James Bond heads to the Bahamas to recover two nuclear warheads stolen by S.P.E.C.T.R.E. Agent Emilio Largo in an international extortion scheme.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 5.0 · 1967 · Casino Royale
metas.description: In an early spy spoof, aging Sir James Bond comes out of retirement to take on SMERSH.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.8 · 1967 · You Only Live Twice
metas.description: James Bond and the Japanese Secret Service must find and stop the true culprit of a series of space hijackings, before war is provoked between Russia and the United States.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 6.7 · 1969 · On Her Majesty's Secret Service
metas.description: British agent James Bond goes undercover to pursue the villainous Ernst Stavro Blofeld, who is planning to hold the world to ransom.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 6.5 · 1971 · Diamonds Are Forever
metas.description: A diamond smuggling investigation leads James Bond to Las Vegas where he uncovers an evil plot involving a rich business tycoon.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 6.7 · 1973 · Live and Let Die
metas.description: James Bond is sent to stop a diabolically brilliant heroin magnate armed with a complex organisation and a reliable psychic tarot card reader.

metas.name: 10 · ★ 6.7 · 1974 · The Man with the Golden Gun
metas.description: James Bond is targeted by the world's most expensive assassin, while he attempts to recover sensitive solar cell technology that is being sold to the highest bidder.

metas.name: 11 · ★ 7.0 · 1977 · The Spy Who Loved Me
metas.description: James Bond investigates the hijacking of British and Russian submarines carrying nuclear warheads, with the help of a K.G.B. agent whose lover he killed.

metas.name: 12 · ★ 6.3 · 1979 · Moonraker
metas.description: James Bond investigates the mid-air theft of a space shuttle, and discovers a plot to commit global genocide.

metas.name: 13 · ★ 6.7 · 1981 · For Your Eyes Only
metas.description: Secret service agent James Bond is assigned to find a missing British vessel equipped with a weapons encryption device and prevent it from falling into enemy hands.

metas.name: 14 · ★ 6.5 · 1983 · Octopussy
metas.description: A fake Fabergé egg recovered from the body of a fellow agent leads James Bond to uncover a jewel smuggling operation led by the mysterious Octopussy, and a plot to blow up a NATO air base.

metas.name: 15 · ★ 6.1 · 1983 · Never Say Never Again
metas.description: James Bond is called upon to try to recover nuclear bombs stolen by Spectre, but he will have to get rid of a professional assassin, hired especially to eliminate him.

metas.name: 16 · ★ 6.3 · 1985 · A View to a Kill
metas.description: The recovery of a microchip from the body of a fellow British secret agent leads James Bond to mad industrialist Max Zorin, who is scheming to cause massive destruction.

metas.name: 17 · ★ 6.7 · 1987 · The Living Daylights
metas.description: James Bond is sent to investigate a KGB policy to kill all enemy spies, and uncovers an arms deal that potentially has major global ramifications.

metas.name: 18 · ★ 6.7 · 1989 · Licence to Kill
metas.description: A vengeful James Bond goes rogue to infiltrate and take down the organization of a drug lord who has murdered his friend's new wife and left him near death.

metas.name: 19 · ★ 7.2 · 1995 · GoldenEye
metas.description: When a powerful secret defense system is stolen, James Bond is assigned to stop a Russian crime syndicate from using it.

metas.name: 20 · ★ 6.5 · 1997 · Tomorrow Never Dies
metas.description: James Bond is sent to disrupt a media mogul's plot to foment a war between China and the United Kingdom.

metas.name: 21 · ★ 6.4 · 1999 · The World Is Not Enough
metas.description: James Bond uncovers a nuclear plot while protecting an oil heiress from her former kidnapper, an international terrorist who can't feel pain.

metas.name: 22 · ★ 6.1 · 2002 · Die Another Day
metas.description: James Bond is sent to investigate the connection between a North Korean terrorist and a diamond mogul, who is funding the development of an international space weapon.

metas.name: 23 · ★ 8.0 · 2006 · Casino Royale
metas.description: After earning a licence to kill, secret agent James Bond sets out on his first mission as 007. Bond must defeat a private banker funding terrorists in a high-stakes game of poker at Casino Royale, in Montenegro.

metas.name: 24 · ★ 6.5 · 2008 · Quantum of Solace
metas.description: James Bond tries to stop an organisation from eliminating a country's most valuable resource.

metas.name: 25 · ★ 7.8 · 2012 · Skyfall
metas.description: James Bond's loyalty to M is tested when her past comes back to haunt her. When MI6 comes under attack, 007 must track down and destroy the threat, no matter how personal the cost.

metas.name: 26 · ★ 6.8 · 2015 · Spectre
metas.description: A cryptic message from James Bond's past sends him on a trail to uncover the existence of a sinister organisation named SPECTRE. With a new threat dawning, Bond learns the terrible truth about the author of all his pain in his mos...

metas.name: 27 · ★ 7.3 · 2021 · No Time to Die
metas.description: James Bond has left active service. His peace is short-lived when Felix Leiter, an old friend from the CIA, turns up asking for help, leading Bond onto the trail of a mysterious villain armed with dangerous new technology.
